name: 涟漪 (Ripple) v0.1.18
body:
## 更新内容 / What's New（安卓 v0.1.18）

这一版主要修了完全锁定的一个漏洞。

如果在完全锁定开始之前提交过放松申请，比如暂停时段、关闭或删除时段、关掉完全锁定，等待时间走完后在锁定期间点确认，以前会直接生效，把正在进行的完全锁定整段解开。现在锁定期间确认会被拦下，申请保留，页面会提示等这段时间结束再来确认。

判断完全锁定是否正在进行时，统一改用涟漪自己的可信时间，改手机系统时间影响不到。

关于匿名计数。从 v0.1.6 起，涟漪每天第一次打开时会匿名计一次数。这一版起，同一次计数会同时发到 GoatCounter 和 PostHog，内容只有平台、版本号、装机天数（GoatCounter 那边是大致区间）、新装还是升级、App 界面语言、是否测试设备，以及一个在手机上随机生成的安装编号，并要求 PostHog 不保存 IP。这个编号不是设备序列号、IMEI 或广告 ID，卸载重装后会变。不带任何使用内容。在「设置」里连点版本号 7 次，可以把这台手机标成测试设备，它的计数会单独归类。

已知限制：这一版还没有在小米真机上复测。小米、OPPO 等机型的后台冻结和无障碍服务被系统关掉的问题，仍需真机确认。部分手机打开受限应用时，仍可能短暂露脸。昨晚有人反馈自律时段和完全锁定都不起作用，这个现象在 v0.1.17 模拟器上没有复现。这一版修的是排查时找到的一个真实问题，不一定就是那次遇到的情况。

iPhone 版没有更新，仍是目前已发布的 v0.1.5。

This release mainly fixes a gap in Complete Lock.

If a request to loosen rules (pause a schedule, turn off or delete a schedule, or turn off Complete Lock) was submitted before Complete Lock started, confirming it after the wait while the lock was active used to take effect right away and lift the whole lock. Now confirming during the lock is refused. The request is kept, and the app asks you to confirm after the period ends.

Checks for whether Complete Lock is active now use Ripple's own trusted time, so changing the phone clock does not affect them.

About the anonymous count. Since v0.1.6, Ripple counts once a day, anonymously, on first open. From this build the same count goes to both GoatCounter and PostHog. It carries only the platform, version, days since install (a rough range on GoatCounter), whether it is a new install or an update, the app language, whether it is a test device, and a random install ID generated on the phone, and it asks PostHog not to store the IP address. The ID is not a device serial number, IMEI, or advertising ID, and it changes after a reinstall. No usage content is included. In Settings, tap the version number 7 times to mark the phone as a test device so its counts are kept apart.

Known limits: this build has not been retested on a Xiaomi phone. Background freeze and accessibility service shutdowns on Xiaomi, OPPO, and similar devices still need real-device checks. On some phones, a restricted app may still flash briefly when opened. A report last night said schedules and Complete Lock stopped working; that was not reproduced on a v0.1.17 emulator. This build fixes one real bug found while investigating, and it may or may not be what was seen that night.

The iPhone app is unchanged and remains the currently published iOS version, v0.1.5.
